events.name: UK Pet Food Annual Convention 2026
events.sector: Pet food manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, regulatory leads, and industry leadership
events.desc: The flagship annual conference hosted by UK Pet Food, representing over 90% of the UK pet food manufacturing market. The convention gathers senior leaders to discuss regulatory developments, market statistics, supply chain resilience, and sustainable nutrition.
reasons: Gathers executive leadership from the major UK pet food manufacturers and importers.
High market intelligence on UK pet food regulation, ingredient trends, and sustainability rules.
Excellent networking for Irish ingredients, private label, and co-manufacturing partners.

events.name: Crufts 2027
events.sector: Pet consumer products, dog food, treats, healthcare, and specialty retail stockists
events.desc: Organized by The Royal Kennel Club, Crufts is the world's largest dog show, featuring over 500 trade stands alongside international canine competitions. While primarily consumer-facing, it offers high brand visibility, direct consumer feedback, and access to independent stockists.
reasons: Unrivalled consumer scale with over 150,000 pet owners attending across four days.
Great platform for direct-to-consumer product testing, brand launch, and sampling.
Includes visits from independent pet shop stockists and boutique retailers.

events.name: PIF Business of Pets Conference 2027
events.sector: Pet industry startups, scaleups, retail buyers, investors, and product innovators
events.desc: A two-day commercial strategy conference organized by the Pet Industry Federation, focusing on market trends, scaling pet businesses, and investment. It features panel discussions, investor pitch sessions, and the PIF Innovation of the Year Award.
reasons: Dedicated strategic event for pet sector entrepreneurs, investors, and retail executives.
High market intelligence value on UK pet consumer behavior, funding, and cost pressures.
Excellent platform for innovative Irish pet brands pitching for UK market growth.

events.name: Global Design Forum 2026 at V&A South Kensington
events.sector: Cross-sector retail design, homeware, material innovation, and creative leadership
events.desc: The flagship thought-leadership conference of London Design Festival, hosted in the Lydia and Manfred Gorvy Lecture Theatre at V&A South Kensington. It gathers design directors, founders, and retail strategists to explore material sustainability, AI in design, and cross-sector retail innovation.
reasons: High concentration of senior creative directors, brand founders, and retail design decision-makers at the UK's premier design institution.
Delivers top-tier market intelligence on consumer design shifts, sustainable materials, and retail concept innovations.
Officially confirmed programme and venue partnership with V&A South Kensington during London Design Festival 2026.

events.name: The Creative Craft Show & Simply Christmas Glasgow 2026
events.location: SEC Centre, Scottish Event Campus, Glasgow
events.sector: Gift, Homeware, Craft & Festive Retail based in Glasgow
events.desc: A major festive retail and gift showcase hosted at Glasgow's SEC Centre. Combining craft, homeware, and festive gift sourcing, it connects Scottish and regional independent retailers, craft stockists, and consumer audiences ahead of the Christmas retail season.
reasons: Fulfills targeted regional focus for Scottish retail buyer access in Glasgow ahead of Christmas trading.
Hosted at the Scottish Event Campus (SEC), providing direct access to regional Scottish store owners and gift buyers.
Targeted platform for Irish gift and homeware brands entering or expanding in the Scottish market.
